description: Looks up recorded spec disputes: where a brand figure and other sources disagree (for example total watts or capacity), with every figure, its condition and its own source URL, and which figure SpecSource adopted (settled) or that it is still open. Search by product or by words in the question.

category.description: Optional. Only claims in this category. One of: "chargers", "power-banks", "usb-c-cables", "mini-pcs", "kvm-switches", "usb-c-docks", "ssds", "nas", "wireless-chargers", "monitors", "memory", "power-supplies", "cpu-coolers", "graphics-cards", "video-cables", "ethernet-cables", "pc-power-cables", "usb-cables". Can be used alone to list a category's claims (up to 10). Example: "ssds".

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

product.description: Optional. The product whose claims to look up: slug, model number or words from its name (1 to 120 characters, case ignored). At least one of product, query or category is required. Example: "PB200U" or "CUKTECH 15 Ultra".

query.description: Optional. Space-separated words (2 to 120 characters) that must all appear in the claim's question, answer, reason or figures, in any of the three languages. Example: "210W" or "TBW".

name: check_spec_claim
title: Check a disputed spec claim
